name: str_to_camel
title: Convert between different types of programming case

origin.description: Join words in camel case. The first letter stays lower unless first_upper is true.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: Input vector. Either a character vector, or something coercible to one.

arguments.name: first_upper
arguments.text: Whether the first letter of the result is capitalized. The default is false.

origin.details: Words are split on non-letters, on a lower-to-upper change, between letters and digits, and at the end of an acronym. The pieces are titled and then joined.
origin.value: A character vector the same length as string.

translation.description: Join words in camel case. The first letter stays lower unless first_upper is true. The result is a list. A missing string is stringi._na.NA.

translation.example:
